summary: Depth-first rabbithole dossier for AAIF and Protocol Governance; source-anchored research pack.

facts.text: IN: how the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) governs its hosted protocols. That covers the legal and fund structure, the Governing Board, the Technical Committee (TC), the project lifecycle, the split between foundation and project authority, and where that governance breaks, stays silent, or is contested. OUT: the internals of the MCP and A2A protocols, sibling foundations (AGNTCY, W3C, IETF, OpenID) except where they show an AAIF boundary, and agent-level "governance" features inside protocols.

**In scope:** how the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) governs the protocol projects it hosts. That covers its funding vehicle, its bodies (Governing Board and Technical Committee), the rules for admitting projects and moving them between lifecycle stages, and how that foundation layer connects to each protocol's own internal governance. MCP and A2A are the worked examples.

IN: how the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) governs its hosted protocols. This covers its legal form, its board and Technical Committee (TC), membership tiers, the project lifecycle policy, how that layer relates to each project's own technical governance (MCP, A2A), and what this means in practice for adopters and contributors. OUT: A2A and MCP wire-level mechanics, comparisons with other agent protocols, the Linux Foundation in general, and sibling concepts in the A2A family. Those are separate frontier items.

18. Since 2026-09-01, AAIF has three phases: Sandbox, Growth and Impact. https://aaif.io/blog/aaif-sandbox-phase 19. Sandbox projects get "standard infrastructure only. No funding, no marketing, no scanning". A Sandbox listing is therefore not an endorsement or a security review. https://aaif.io/blog/aaif-sandbox-phase 20. To reach Growth, a project needs production use by two unaffiliated organizations and multi-organization commits over six months. https://aaif.io/blog/aaif-sandbox-phase 21. If a Sandbox project misses the 12-month window to reach Growth, the TC opens an archival discussion.
